cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay. Serve him my pie on a warm plate, please; an extra guest gets the same standard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Peas will do for me. A warm bowl, not an empty dinner plate; we needn't make the portion look any smaller.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It will take forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. Serve everyone else now, please, not when mine arrives. I'll keep my place laid while I watch them finish.

reason: Use precise service and plating corrections to accommodate the guest while A increasingly visible sacrifice remains gracious rather than angry.
